{{Quote|Back off! This is a legal operation.|The mine operator, to Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="BFN" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''mine operator''' was in charge of a [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Plasma mining camp|camp]] affiliated with [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet. The operator [[Search for Captain Kael|encountered]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] at the camp during the invasion. After the individual refused to give information and had the mine defenses fire on Sykes, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] destroyed the mining camp.

==Biography==
[[File:Borvo.png|thumb|left|210px|The mine operator worked for Borvo the Hutt (pictured).]]
During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual ran a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] camp [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|owned]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The camp was designed to search for [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] resources on Naboo<ref name="BFN" /> and also served as a plasma shipping site for the Trade Federation.<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] began attacking the camp with several [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tanks]], and a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] resembling Borvo's [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|personal transport]] left the scene during the skirmish. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]' [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]], traveling in a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|speeder]], was [[Search for Captain Kael|searching]] for his downed [[Flight leader/Legends|flight leader]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]], at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] and discovered the mining operation.<ref name="BFN" />

After destroying the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were attacking the camp, Sykes radioed the mine operator, demanding to know who was in charge there. The operator responded with hostility, insisting that his mine was a legal operation. However, his words did not deter Sykes' questions about Kael, and when Sykes refused to heed the operator's final warning, the operator ordered his remaining [[Laser cannon/Legends|defenses]] to fire on the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. That forced Sykes to retaliate by defending himself and destroying the camp.<ref name="BFN" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This base is programmed to defend itself. This is your last warning.|The mine operator|<ref name="BFN" />}}
The mine operator became hostile when Sykes demanded to know who was in charge of his mine. He was also protective of his camp, and he ordered his turrets to fire on Sykes.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mine operator was a minor character created for the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. His only dialogue comes from the game's cutscenes. Although Sykes destroys the camp's main building, the operator was not confirmed to be in it.<ref name="BFN" />
